title: Discipline in School and Cloister
summary: "Discipline in School and Cloister" by Dr. Jacobus X. is a historical account written in the early 20th century. The book is likely to interest readers who are drawn to discussions about discipline, educational methods, and societal values surrounding authority and punishment throughout history.
